name: v1.17.0
body:
## What's Changed

The documentation website [revive.run](https://revive.run/) has been rebuilt with [Hugo](https://gohugo.io/), replacing the Gatsby site that had served the docs since 2018 (#74). See [mgechev/revive.run#89](https://github.com/mgechev/revive.run/pull/89) by @alexandear, closes #1647.

### Features
* Add new rule `use-slices-concat` by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1804
* `identical-switch-branches`: add `allow-identical-default` option by @vaibhav8a in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1779
* `unexported-return`: do not allow unexported interfaces by @tie in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1458
* `redefines-builtin-id`: report `comparable` by @dylanpulver in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1786
* `deep-exit`: improve report message by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1802

> [!IMPORTANT]
> `unexported-return` and `redefines-builtin-id` now report code that previous versions accepted, so existing projects may see new findings after upgrading.

### Bug Fixes
* `redundant-test-main-exit`: check only the return from `m.Run` by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1803
* `enforce-slice-style`: suggest nil expressions by @fzlzjerry in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1790
* Keep rule disabled on repeated disable directive by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1796
* Add missed category and `ConfigurableRule` assertion by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1798

### Documentation
* Add release strategy by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1801
* Add info about website contribution by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1793
* Add Copilot code review instructions by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1797
* Update GH templates; lint nested md files by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1784
* Update revive docker version by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1782

### Dependency Updates
* Update module github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/v2 to v2.13.2 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1787
* Update module golang.org/x/mod to v0.41.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1788
* Update module golang.org/x/tools to v0.50.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1792
* Update golang docker tag to v1.27.1 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1791

### Chores & Internal
* Check only exported functions by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1795
* Keep only the error-path cases in `rule` by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1794
* Update AGENTS.md with Go version and starring by @alexandear in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1778

## New Contributors
* @vaibhav8a made their first contribution in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1779
* @dylanpulver made their first contribution in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1786
* @fzlzjerry made their first contribution in https://github.com/mgechev/revive/pull/1790

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mgechev/revive/compare/v1.16.0...v1.17.0
